subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: We know that trees are very important (a) _____ they produce oxygen (b) _____ is a must for all living creatures. They are our best friends (c) _____ we are not conscious of it. Time is coming (d) _____ there will be no tree left for us. (e) _____ , we should plant more and more trees for our own sake.
guide_solution: (a) because (b) which (c) but (d) when (e) So/Therefore/that’s why
